title: Break the idol and what it held comes out of it
what: A stone hand taller than a man stands in a ring of twelve candles on a brick drum in a moat. Shooting it breaks it, and four phantoms come out of where it stood.
recipe: Hand: tile 2348, kThingObjectGib (416), destroyed sends tx 155 command 1; four kMarkerDudeSpawn (18) rx 155, data_1 210, 250 units round it in the same sector, 8000 up. Drum 2048 across and 26624 high inside a moat of 2915; candles 938 (type 32) on its rim.
use: Any guarded statue that is itself the trigger: the museum, the park's monument, the church.
